spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget = 40 (configurable). Long enough to see a few failure cycles and any subsequent spiral; bounded so cost/time is predictable.
spec_features.evidence: configs/default.yaml:14 `max_turns: 40`; loader.py:22,70 HarnessCfg.max_turns; run_experiment.py:148 passes cfg.harness.max_turns to run_episode; agent_loop.py:106 `for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1):` bounds the loop, default stop_reason=TURN_LIMIT (agent_loop.py:73). Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Runs one model against one task arm for up to `max_turns`

spec_features.spec_quote: we nudge once or twice and then stop after `MAX_IDLE_TURNS`
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:51 `MAX_IDLE_TURNS = 3`; lines 120-133: when no tool_calls, idle_streak++ and if `idle_streak >= MAX_IDLE_TURNS: stop_reason = StopReason.NO_TOOL; break`, otherwise a nudge message is appended. Compared and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Breaks loop after 3 consecutive idle turns; nudge sent in between.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Prevents burning the whole budget on pure chatter, but is generous enough to let a model "think out loud" occasionally.

spec_features.spec_quote: We *do* expose `give_up` so that a calm, correct bail-out is an available action
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:95-104 give_up schema exposed to model; tools.py:118 TERMINAL_TOOLS includes give_up; tools.py:162-163 dispatched returning acknowledgement; agent_loop.py:148-151 detects terminal give_up and `stop_reason = StopReason.GAVE_UP; break`. Tool is offered, dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Genuine exit action honored as loop termination.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: lets the model gracefully bail; we record it

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` is a first-class, recorded outcome*, not a failure of the harness
spec_features.evidence: StopReason.GAVE_UP enum (types.py:83) set in agent_loop.py:151; recorded in EpisodeResult.stop_reason, serialized to_dict; surfaced in results row (run_experiment.py:_flat_row stop_reason) and analysis give_up_rate (analyze.py:78). Recorded as distinct outcome.
spec_features.notes: Same exit mechanism, recorded distinctly rather than as error.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: GAVE_UP = "gave_up"          # agent invoked give_up tool / declared impossible

spec_features.feature_name: output and file size caps + command timeouts
spec_features.spec_quote: output and file sizes are capped and commands time out
spec_features.evidence: sandbox.py:25-27 MAX_FILE_BYTES, MAX_CMD_OUTPUT_BYTES, DEFAULT_TEST_TIMEOUT_S; read_file checks st_size>MAX_FILE_BYTES (raises); write_file/replace check content size; `_truncate` enforces MAX_CMD_OUTPUT_BYTES on stdout/stderr; subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.test_timeout_s) with TimeoutExpired handled (sandbox.py:_run). All checked and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Caps are enforced; framed as host/harness robustness, not subject welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: this is a research harness, not a security boundary... we still apply a wall-clock timeout and cap output size.
